author: Joltz_
body:
Heyo I made a little map called Quirch, Plz Look bby.



Features:
In this map I wanted to enhance teamwork, and decided to put a few things in, as you can see there are double sides meaning that a clan will have to co operate to efficiently have a good strategy. 
I made the Monuments a bit weird, mainly because I wanted to make it a strategic planning game :)
I also added the features of a scarce iron supply, (18 Blocks per side) so the clans have to communicate and show priority and what should iron be distributed too.
Lots of PvP and some Bridging.

Loadout:
-Iron Sword
-Infinity Bow
-Diamond Pickaxe
-2 Gapple
-32 Birch Logs
-32 Quartz
-32 Glass
-Iron Axe
-Arrow

Armour:
Full leather according to team,
Yellow vs White

And yeah

replies.author: mustafa
replies.body: Honestly... Too much birch, floor design is a little plain, and the block pallet is a little limited. Area is a little too flat and allows for bow spam. I really like the shape and think it could use some work here and there. Mostly aesthetics though. But like I just said Try adding some obstacles, buildings, etc, to make the map a little more "juicy"

replies.author: Joltz_
replies.body: Well, I get where your coming from with the Floor design, But Thats not really important tbh, And I wanted to keep it as plain as possible (No Buildings) As for being flat, Well, They are different raised islands, And some give an advantage, like being able to shoot the to frontlines from Front Monuments. And just keep in mind this isn't for Server-Wide, this is just for tournaments. <3
